meta.title: Material Master Import: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify whether Material Master Import is refused or absent.
Use Material Master Import to import and auto-maintain the material master from ERP PRs.
Repeat the action as a Tenant Admin and compare availability in the same tenant.
Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
